| **Country Operating Boards (COBs)** | Market‑level strategy, regulatory compliance, cultural alignment. | Country CEO + CFO + Local Compliance Lead + HR Lead. | 70 % voting on all matters; 30 % for group‐wide initiatives. |
| **Technical Integration Office (TIO)** | Architecture, migration, security. | Head of Digital, Platform Architect, Cyber‑Security Lead, Cloud Ops Lead. | Technical standards, risk‑control policies, vendor selection. |
| **Regulatory Liaison Teams (RLTs)** | Continuous regulator dialogue, approvals, filings. | Country‑specific Liaison + Legal Counsel. | Regulatory submissions, exemption requests. |
| **Cross‑Border Excellence Committee (CBC)** | Sustain best practices, joint projects, cross‑border talent flow. | Senior Regional Heads, COO, Chief Human Resources Officer. | Portfolio prioritisation, cross‑country KPI alignment. |

### Governance Process  
1. **Charter Signing** – Q1 2027.  
2. **Quarterly G‑ISC Review** – KPI dashboards, milestone status, risk heat‑map.  
3. **Escalation Flow** – Issue escalated to G‑ISC only after COB resolution.

## 3. Technology Migration Roadmap  

### 3.1 Architecture Layers  

| Layer | Description | Rationale | Key Deliverables |
|-------|-------------|-----------|------------------|
| **Data Mesh (Operational)** | Independent data domains served via secure APIs. | Enables local autonomy while centralising analytics. | Data domain APIs, security policy catalogue. |
| **Enterprise Risk & Compliance Hub** | Centralised AML, KYC, Basel III analytics. | Unified risk view across the Group. | Real‑time risk dashboard, regulatory reporting engine. |
| **Unified Core‑Banking Platform** | Cloud‑native core (Temenos, Finacle or Acadia) per region with multi‑tenant licence. | Standardised product logic, easier scaling. | Core migration plan, test harness integration. |
| **Digital Experience Platform (DXP)** | Multi‑language mobile/online portal with AI‑chat, biometrics. | Consistent UI/UX, higher engagement. | App release, API gateway, omni‑channel routing. |

### 3.2 Migration Phases  

| Phase | Duration | Target | Key Actions |
|-------|----------|--------|-------------|
| **Phase 0 – Business Continuity** | 0–6 mo | Dual run of legacy cores + API gateways | • Deploy API gateways; establish real‑time event bus. • Data backup strategy. |
| **Phase 1 – Hybrid Overlay** | 6–18 mo | Middleware core overlay for high‑value product migration | • Open‑source SOA core (Open‑Core) on a Kubernetes cluster. • Migrate Corporate, Wealth, SME products first. |
| **Phase 2 – Unified Core Rollout** | 18–36 mo | Full core replacement and de‑commission of legacy systems | • Adopt Temenos Cloud Banking (regional compliant). • Sequential migration: Morocco → Kenya → Nigeria. |
| **Phase 3 – Digital Experience Layer** | 36–48 mo | Unified front‑end, omni‑channel journey | • Build DXP with multi‑language UI and AR/VR banking demos. • Consolidate fintech APIs (Open Banking, QR‑payments). |

### Risk Controls  
- **Control Tower** – real‑time telemetry on data flows, system health, SLA compliance.  
- **Dual‑Run Certification** – 100 % transaction reconciliation before cut‑over.  
- **Rollback Playbooks** – pre‑defined scripts for each migration checkpoint.  
- **Change‑Impact Matrix** – continuous mapping of functional changes to regulatory risk.
